description: Java class implementing a Freemarker TemplateTransformModel for rendering content as text within the OFBiz framework. It handles content rendering, XML escaping, and optional edit link wrapping.

classes.name: RenderContentAsText
classes.description: Freemarker transform class for rendering content as text, implementing TemplateTransformModel.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Creates a custom Writer that renders content as text, handling content retrieval, XML escaping, and optional edit link wrapping.

methods.name: renderSubContent
methods.description: Performs the actual content rendering, including locale determination, XML escaping, and error handling.

methods.name: openEditWrap
methods.description: Wraps the content in an editable div with specified style.

methods.name: closeEditWrap
methods.description: Closes the edit wrapper and adds an edit link.

methods.name: getEditStyle
methods.description: Retrieves the style for the edit wrapper, defaulting to 'buttontext'.
